title: samples/1: roles and times of the files of a series
description: One entry per file, in the order of injection: the one model of the roles and times of the Data view and of mzFinder (mzlab-core samples). Proposed from the names by `propose` (times never confirmed), checked by `validate`, read by the TP path through `per_tp`. Canonical JSON: keys in alphabetical order, so the same metadata give the same bytes and the same SHA-256.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw file: the key (the name can change); empty when not known yet

blank_kind.description: optional, only for a blank: solvent and procedure blanks are subtracted the same way; a wash is no reference

time.description: the time as written or confirmed, in time_unit

time_min.description: derived from time and time_unit: the only time used in the computations; 0 for a t0

time_confirmed.description: false for a time proposed from the name: never used before the user confirms it

series.description: the experiment the file belongs to; empty = the only one, or shared by all

istd.description: the file is an internal standard

compound.description: for an infusion: formula or name of the parent
